Alyssa: Quick plan — microtest for webinar teaser. We want 2 x posts on X and 1 LinkedIn thread. Target: devs & platform leads. Need final GIF, 2 caption variants, and short TL;DR for threads. Drop assets by EOD today pls. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/webinar-teaser
Devon: I can schedule X posts 11am & 5pm PST Tue/Wed
Marta: Draft captions ready, pushing to figma comments now. Two tones: pragmatic + playful.
Sam: Routing — send inbound leads to /webinar-2026?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=teaser. Who owns the SDR follow-up flow?
Nico: GIF export in 480x480 + webp max 2MB. Uploading to the figma file in 5.
Alyssa: @Sam can you own SDR flow? If not @Devon?
Sam: I got it. Will wire Zapier <> HubSpot. Need utm params confirmed.
Devon: Confirmed. Scheduler snippet:
```
cron: 0 18 * * 2,3 # 6pm UTC Tue/Wed
platform: Buffer -> X
```
Marta: Caption A (pragmatic): "Ship LLM features faster with predictable inference. Join our webinar -> link" Caption B (playful): "Your app deserves faster LLM responses. We'll show how. 👀 -> link"
Alyssa: Nice. Can we A/B caption A vs B on X for 24h and pass top performers to LinkedIn thread?

amp-bot: Reminder: asset deadline in 6 hours for marketing channel.
